description: Poll and wait until an entity reaches a specific spatial condition (exists, active, confidence threshold, or enters region). Read-only polling tool. Default timeout: 10000ms, poll_interval: 500ms. On timeout returns {ok: false, timeout: true}. Returns {ok, condition_met:boolean, entity}. Use wait_for_spatial_state instead of query_entities when polling asynchronously for an entity state transition or region entry.

region_id.description: Target region ID for in_region condition

name: wait_for_spatial_state
